data.narrative:
Baykar is a private-stage defense and security company founded by Özdemir Bayraktar. The valuation analysis draws from a frontier-tech comp universe spanning 2 public peers (DRSHF, IDEAFORGE.NS) and 8 private peers including Anduril Industries, Helsing, Castelion, Shield AI, and Saronic.

Peer-median methodology could not be applied due to insufficient narrow peer set within Defense & Security. Of 26 same-sector peers identified, none met the filtering criteria of same-stage, adjacent-stage, or similar-valuation-tier peers—a minimum of 3 datapoints was required. Applying an all-sector median would introduce material measurement error and was therefore rejected.

The absence of reliable triangulation methods limits the quantitative valuation support available from this dataset. Alternative approaches (DCF, revenue or EBITDA multiple analysis, or deal-flow comparables) would require operational and financial disclosure not provided here. Given only 2 public comps and 8 private peers without stage or valuation alignment, any single-method estimate would rest on insufficient cross-validation. A credible valuation range cannot be responsibly established from the current data. Further diligence should prioritize acquisition of revenue, growth, or comparable transaction multiples within the narrow frontier-defense cohort, and clarification of Baykar's current funding stage and capital structure.
